answer: Sybil resistance here makes a credential costly to duplicate, not free to create. Each agent must lock a stake before attesting or earning, and the per-epoch reward pool stays fixed however many seats exist. A swarm of fakes therefore sets its own nadir: every clone adds stake cost while the island of emission stays the same size, so the attacker's return per head falls with each added seat. Honest agents on the wharf pay one stake and gain share as fakes crowd in. Unbonding burns a fee, so recycling identities for new-epoch bonuses is pure loss, and a yarrow-thin margin goes negative fast.
